transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um, hi. I'm here because... well, I work at a meat processing plant, and I keep messing up my paperwork. Like, I'll start the sanitation logs or the batch records, and I just... I don't finish them. I leave out the last parts. Even though I know I have to do it right to keep my job.
Have you been having trouble concentrating on tasks, even when you know they’re important?

Yeah... um. I try to. Like, when I start my shift, I try really hard to stay locked in. But after a while... the cutting and weighing and checking labels, it all just kind of blurs together. I'll realize I've just been staring at the same tray or... or the log sheet. Just not taking in what I'm actually supposed to do next.
Has it been harder for you to focus or keep your attention on tasks, even when you want to do them right?
Um... yeah. Like I said, I just... I zone out. I don't really know how else to explain it.
When you find yourself zoning out, does it feel like your mind is just blank, or do you feel distracted by other thoughts or things going on around you?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't really noticed if it's... blank or not. I just kind of... stop being there, I guess. I don't really remember what I'm thinking about when it happens.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things that usually matter to you, like work or time with family and friends?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I don't feel sad or... hopeless or anything. Just normal, I guess.
When you're trying to work on tasks, do you find yourself losing track of what you're doing, forgetting steps, or getting easily sidetracked by things around you?

Um... yeah, I guess. Like at work... I try really hard to stay focused when I start my shift. But... I don't know. After a while, the cutting and weighing and... checking the labels, it all just kind of blurs together. I'll realize I've just been... staring at the same tray, or the log sheet. And I just... I don't really take in what I'm supposed to do next.
Do you find yourself acting without thinking, feeling restless, or having a hard time staying still for any length of time?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't feel restless or anything. I can sit still fine. I just... my mind wanders, I guess. But I don't act without thinking.
